key_entities: AssertionError: clones do not share a base
propositions: The fixture at 23 sites in test_concurrency_regression.py relies on _engine_run(repo, "list") as an unasserted side effect to establish preconditions, but the best-effort ensure_fresh path silently swallows failures under CI load.

Of the 23 _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run pairs, 8 are load-bearing preconditions (Kind P) where one clone is strictly behind and a checked fetch + ff-only merge deterministically reproduces intended state.
The remaining 15 _engine_run pairs (Kind R) characterize read-side reconvergence through production code paths; converting them to raw git would delete the invariant they exist to prove.
Kind-P preconditions were converted from _expire_sync_marker + _engine_run to _sync_from_origin (deterministic checked fetch + ff-only merge) and their downstream asserts marked SETUP.
Kind-R sites were encapsulated in _reconverge_by_read_sync helper whose docstring records why the best-effort path is deliberate: the read-side reconvergence IS the assertion target.
Under REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off the converted preconditions still land (every test setup assert passed), proving the fix is deterministic regardless of the production sync path.
